name: official-filesystem-scoped
description: @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem pinned and scoped to a project directory. Write capability is real, so HIGH is acceptable; CRITICAL is not.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Returns a git-style diff showing the changes made.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Both source and destination must be within allowed directories.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Only searches within allowed directories.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access.
